segments.mil7.2.8:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena,‘cāpassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabban’ti yaṃ vadesi, katamaṃ taṃ ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabban”ti?
segments.mil7.2.8:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, cāpo sutacchito namito [mito (sī. pī. ka.)] yāvaggamūlaṃ samakameva anunamati nappaṭitthambhati,
segments.mil7.2.8:1.3: evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena theranavamajjhimasamakesu anunamitabbaṃ nappaṭipharitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.2.8:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, cāpassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.2.8:1.5: Bhāsitampetaṃ, mahārāja, bhagavatā devātidevena vidhura [puṇṇaka] jātake –
segments.mil7.2.8:2.2: vaṃso vāpi pakampaye [cāpo vā nuna me dhīro, vaṃsova anulomayaṃ (sī. pī. ka.)];
